## Overview

An imported post keeps its <abbr title="HyperText Markup Language">HTML</abbr>, its
<kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>K</kbd> shortcuts, and its <a href="../glossary/">relative links</a>, while
<span onclick="steal()" onmouseover="steal()">event handlers</span> and
<a href="https://partner.example/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">link targets</a> go. Inline
code in <script>steal(document.cookie)</script> tags is dropped.
